name: Greenwood Day Camp
description_short: The town of Longmeadow's licensed day camp at the Greenwood Center, for children entering kindergarten through grade 7. A typical day has swim lessons and free swim at the Greenwood Pool, arts and crafts, sports, group games and STEM, with campers grouped by grade. Camp runs 9 am to 4 pm, with extended care available.
special_needs_notes: Parents are asked to tell the department about a disability at least two weeks before camp so it can make or discuss accommodations, and to share an IEP with the Camp Coordinator.
